title: Signed chain representative of the normalized integral Hom comparison
statement: Fix universes $d,t,u$, a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme $Y$ in universe $t$, a finite-field datum $D$ in universe $d$ with characteristic unequal to $\ell$, a tensor presentation $a$ and a level-$n$ reduction presentation $m$ [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models]. Put $R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$, let $F$ be derived reduction to $R_n=(\mathcal O_E/\varpi^{n+1})_Y$ and $U$ its derived restriction of scalars [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction]. For arbitrary $K,L\in D(R)$ there exist complexes $P,I,Q$ of $R$-module sheaves, with $P$ K-flat, $I$ K-injective, isomorphisms $QP\simeq K$ and $QI\simeq L$ (here $Q$ applied to a complex denotes localization), support of the coefficient complex $Q$ in degrees $-1,0$, and isomorphisms of each of these two terms with the unit module. There exists a chain map $f:T(H(P,I),Q)\to H(P,T(I,Q))$ satisfying the signed local formula of [lem-sf-two-term-free-hom-tensor-components]. There are isomorphisms $s:UF(H_R(K,L))\simeq Q(T(H(P,I),Q))$ and $t:U(H_{R_n}(FK,FL))\simeq Q(H(P,T(I,Q)))$ such that $U(c_{m,K,L});t=s;Q(f)$, where $c$ is the specified transpose of reduced evaluation. This asserts a representative and its normalization, with no assertion that $f$ or $c$ is invertible.

proof.text: Choose a K-flat resolution P of a localization preimage of K. Localize its quasi-isomorphism and compose with the preimage isomorphism to represent K. Independently, functorial K-injective resolution of a localization preimage of L gives I and its representing isomorphism.
Obtain the augmented K-flat two-term coefficient resolution Q. Apply the signed exchange theorem to the fixed complexes P,I,Q to get f and its signed formula.
Apply the normalization-square theorem to P,I,Q, the representing isomorphisms, the augmentation, and f. Assemble these witnesses and the square into the asserted existential statement.

theorem comparison_representative
    (a : TensorPresentation.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl))
    (n : ℕ) (m : ReductionPresentation l E Y D hl a n)
    (K L : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl) :
    let R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl
    let U := scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n
    let F := integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl n
    ∃ (P I Q : CochainComplex (Modules.{t, u} Y R) ℤ)
      (_ : flat.{t, u} Y R P) (_ : I.IsKInjective)
      (_ : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅ K))
      (_ : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ L))
      (hzero : ∀ k : ℤ, k ≠ -1 → k ≠ 0 → IsZero (Q.X k))
      (eNeg : Q.X (-1) ≅ (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from SheafOfModules.unit
        ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R)))
      (eZero : Q.X 0 ≅ (show Modules.{t, u} Y R from SheafOfModules.unit
        ((sheafCompose (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max u (t + 1)} RingCat.{max u (t + 1)})).obj R)))
      (f : ((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
          (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) P I)).obj Q ⟶
        homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) P
          (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I).obj Q)),
      IsSignedHomTensor.{t, u} Y R P I Q f ∧
      ∃ (s : U.obj (F.obj ((hom.{t, u} Y R).obj (op K, L))) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj
            (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) P I)).obj Q))
        (t : U.obj ((hom.{t, u} Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n)).obj
            (op (F.obj K), F.obj L)) ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj
            (homComplex.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1), max u (t + 1)} (R := R) P
              (((totalTensor.{t, u} Y R).obj I).obj Q))),
        U.map (comparison l E Y D hl m K L) ≫ t.hom = s.hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map f
